title: fix(objectql)!: a running install or reload is asked the record-currency follow door once, at the end of its registration run
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DTyMkDb5oXTHTFgn9dMf5A5)_

Fixes #32483

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` teaches how to write a line amount that follows its parent (`PARENT_FIELD.CODE_FIELD`, the parent's `iso_4217_currency` field) and the `record` roll-up over it, which this diff does not change; no skill says which door refuses a bad pair or what an install or a reload answers for one. The `content/docs` sentence this diff makes false (`content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx`: a code package installed or reloaded on a running server is not judged) is rewritten here.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：服务器运行中安装、升级或热重载代码包时，系统在这一整次登记结束后统一检查一次「金额跟随父记录币种」的配对：子表金额指向的父对象字段必须是币种代码字段；按父币种汇总的汇总字段只能汇总跟随父币种的金额。不成立就整次拒绝并撤回：安装接口返回 422 并带上原因，热重载保留原来在用的定义并在日志里写明是哪一对。
- 为什么改：以前只有单个保存、发布和批量写入做这项检查，运行中安装的包从不检查。坏配对装上以后，这些金额的每次写入要么被拒、要么被标成错误的币种。上一轮按「每个包单独检查」的做法会误拒合法的包（币种字段由同一批里后一个包或顶层对象补上），所以这次改成整批登记完再检查一次。
- 风险与回滚：属于收窄（BREAKING）。四点：① 一次热重载里只要有一对跨包的坏配对，现在整次重载都撤回，运行中的应用保留之前的定义，日志点名这一对。先例是 `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` 的 `refreshReloadedPackages`，它调用 `refusePicklistArrival(..., { act: 'reload' })` 时已经是整次拒绝重载。② 之前已装好的坏配对包，冷启动照常加载，但它下一次升级或重载会被拒，直到改好。③ 只持有配对一端的包（只有父对象，或只有子对象）也会被问：另一端在别的包或本环境手里且有问题时，这个包哪怕自己没改也会被拒；拒绝会点名出问题的对象和字段，由它的持有者去改，改好后原包照原样再装即可。④ 配对按服务器实际提供的对象来判。某个对象若由本环境自己建的同名对象提供（盖在包的定义之上）：它有币种代码字段，包的升级和重载照常通过；它没有，而包在升级里新加了币种字段和跟随它的金额，这次升级会被当场拒绝（已裁定按 A）。这时提示语会说明包本身的定义没问题、是环境自己的同名对象缺这个字段，并且不给补救办法，因为目前产品内没有。回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `restoringOnRefusal` 与 `recordCurrencyFollowRefusalOfRun`（何时问、问哪些层、嵌套登记如何撤回）；`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` 的 `registerReloadedArtifact`（重载并成一次登记）；`packages/objectql/src/manifest-service-artifact-refusal-restores.test.ts` 末尾两个 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/manifest-service-artifact-refusal-restores.test.ts`，预期 31 条全过，其中 21 条是本 PR 新增。
- 需要你做的：收窄与「按 A 当场拒绝」你已同意（卡片评论 6840575885）。契约复审的增量部分由席位来跑，通过后落地。

## What changes

**The unit that is asked.** The record-currency follow door (ADR-0144 D2 and D6, amended; `recordCurrencyFollowRefusal`) was asked of a single save or publish and of the batch writers, never of a code package registered on a running server. `SchemaRegistry.restoringOnRefusal` now ends the OUTERMOST registration run, on a registry the cold boot has sealed, by asking the door of every object layer the run registered: each package's `objects` and `objectExtensions`, its nested plugins' objects, the artifact's top-level objects (the residual), and on a reload the flat objects it ingests. Each layer is asked exactly as a single save of it would be, with the whole run registered. A refusal is thrown from inside the run, so the run is put back like any other refused one.

**Who hears it.**

- An install or upgrade through the engine's `manifest` service: `RecordCurrencyFollowRefusedError`, `INVALID_METADATA` / 422, in `defineStack`'s words. `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` already maps a declared 4xx to `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` on both branches (`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, read, not changed), with nothing registered or ledgered.
- A reload (`metadata:reloaded`): every package and object keeps the definition it served, and the log says `reload refused` with the pair.

**A reload is one registration run (premise corrected).** The card reads a reload as joining one restore run. On `main` it is not one: each package is its own `registerApp` run inside a per-package `try`/`catch`, and the flat `payload.metadata.objects` register outside any run. Asked at the end of each of those, a reload that adds the code field in one package and makes another package's amount follow it would be judged half against the version that served. `registerReloadedArtifact` (new, `plugin.ts`) wraps `refreshReloadedPackages` and `ingestReloadedObjects` in one run. The seat ruled this no product fork, on the precedent that `refreshReloadedPackages` already refuses a reload whole when `refusePicklistArrival(..., { act: 'reload' })` refuses it. In business words: one bad cross-package pair in a reload now undoes that whole reload, the running app keeps the previous definitions, and the log names the pair.

**A nested run puts back its own writes.** `restoringOnRefusal` called inside an open run used to join it. It is now a part of that run that puts back its own writes before it throws; when nothing catches the throw the open run puts back the rest, so what is left is the same as before. A caller that does catch it goes on with the open run as it stood before the nested one. That keeps today's reload behaviour inside the one run: a package that cannot re-register is skipped alone while the others reload. A nested run that ends without a refusal hands its record to the open run and never asks the door itself.

**Which layers are asked.** A layer is asked only if it is still in the registry at the run's end and the served object reads it. An owner layer under the environment's own object of the same name is not asked: that object is the base that is served (`resolveObject`), and asking the owner beneath it would refuse a package over a code field the served object holds.

**One end is enough to be asked.** The door reads the other end of a pair from the registry. A package that holds only the parent, or only the child, is therefore refused over a child, or a parent, that another package or the environment holds, also when its own objects did not change. The refusal names the object and field that hold the declaration, and the correction is their holder's. This is how a single save of that object is judged today; the upgrade-guide entry, the changeset and the currency page now say it.

**A refusal only the environment's own object earns says so (ruled A).** A pair is judged against the object the server serves. Where that is the environment's own object of the same name, lying over the one a package ships, and it lacks the other end, the run is refused although the package's own definitions hold the pair, and the door's sentence would tell the author to correct a declaration that is not wrong. So a refused run asks once more with each such object read through its package's definition (`followRefusalAsServed`, using `resolveOwnerLayer`). Where that clears the refusal, the sentence ends by naming the object and saying that the correction does not apply. The code, the status and the refused object and field are unchanged. It names no remedy: the product has none for this case today.

**Not asked, as before:** the cold boot (the seal is set at `kernel:bootstrapped`, after `kernel:ready` and the install ledger's rehydrate), the stored-row hydration, any bare `registerObject` outside a run, a draft save (body only), and `restoreArtifactRegistryView`. The batch writers' judge throws inside its own run, so the run's end is never reached there.

**Docblocks rewritten to the tree** in `registry.ts` (`objectRegistrationRefusal`, its `againstRegistry` option, `judgeRegistrationDoors`, the inline comment at the door) and `record-currency-aggregate-door.ts` (`recordCurrencyFollowRefusal`): they said a multi-registration unit hears a refusal only as a log line and that `againstRegistry` is not for a batch or an install. `engine-registration.ts` gains a comment at `registerApp`'s run; `content/docs/data-modeling/currency.mdx` says what an install, an upgrade and a reload answer, and that the other end of a pair is read from what is registered.

**Upgrade guide.** One new ADR-0087 semantic entry, `record-currency-follow-pair-refused-on-install-and-reload` (no conversion: only the author knows which parent field holds the code). It is owed: `check:adr-0087-registration` refuses the no-prescription exemption on a changeset declaring `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`. It names the one-end class with the correction on the holder, and the served-object case with no remedy.

## Tests

`packages/objectql/src/manifest-service-artifact-refusal-restores.test.ts` (the shared artifact harness: a real `ObjectKernel` with `ObjectQLPlugin`, sealed by `bootstrap()`), two new top-level `describe`s, 21 cases:

- Admitted: the package's own `objectExtensions` supplies the code field; a LATER member supplies it; the residual supplies it on an upgrade while a body starts following it; an upgrade that renames the code field in one member and re-points the amount in another (the parent judged is the new one); a package upgraded under the environment's own object of the parent's name, which holds the followed code.
- Refused `INVALID_METADATA` / 422, nothing of the artifact left: a bad pair in a body, in the residual, in a nested plugin's objects, a `record` roll-up over an amount that follows nothing across two members, a parent another installed package owns, an upgrade whose parent drops the code a later member still follows (the installed version of every member keeps serving), the overlay control (same upgrade, no overlay), and an upgrade whose new child follows a code field the environment's own object of the parent's name does not hold, whose refusal must END with the sentence saying the package is not what is wrong; its control (a pair the package's own parent does not hold either) is refused in the door's words alone.
- One end only: a package holding just the parent, re-registered unchanged over another package's child that follows a field it lacks, is refused naming the child's field, and installs once that package corrects its child; a package holding just the child, re-registered unchanged under another package's `record` roll-up, is refused naming the roll-up, and installs once its amount follows the parent.
- A cold boot registers the same bad pair unasked.
- Reload: both ends moved across two members reloads; a body refused inside the reload is skipped whole while the others reload; a bad pair refuses the whole reload and logs it with both package ids; a bad pair arriving in the reload's flat objects does the same.

`packages/objectql/src/record-currency-guards.test.ts`: two existing pins re-titled to what is now true (a bare `registerObject` is not asked; a post-seal `registerApp` whose own extension supplies the code field installs because its run is asked at its end), plus a post-seal `registerApp` with a bad pair refused in `defineStack`'s words and the same call before the seal registering.

`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-register-refusal.test.ts`: one `describe`, 3 cases, test only. The cloud-fetched and the inline branch answer `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` with the engine's sentence, nothing registered or ledgered; the control installs.

**Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored with the tree clean), all ten re-run on the final head `e63ab141c1` under the verify lock. A to I run over the two objectql files (92 cases); A is also run over the install-local file (34 cases):

## Acceptance notes

- **Reload premise.** Corrected in the claim and above: the reload was not one run, and this PR makes it one. A package that cannot re-register for any other reason is still skipped alone (pinned, ablation D).
- **Layers the served object does not read are not asked.** Pinned both ways (ablation E and its control).
- **Ruled A (card comment 6840575885): refused on the spot.** An upgrade whose new child follows a code field that the served parent lacks, where the served parent is the environment's own object of that name lying over the package's, is refused 422. The refusal states that fact and names no remedy. There is no in-product remedy for this case today: that was measured through the real write doors in a run that is not part of this diff, and one item is with the seat.
- **One end only (contract review S1).** Named in the upgrade-guide entry, the changeset and the currency page, with the correction on the holder of the declaration the refusal names; pinned in both directions with the correction that clears each.
- **A stale clause left in place, outside this surface.** `packages/metadata-protocol/src/registry-question.ts`'s header says the follow door is one "which nothing else asks". A registration run now asks it too. Not edited here (another package, not in the claimed surface); #32934 carries it.
- **`restoringOnRefusal` for a nested caller that catches.** The three callers in the tree are the `manifest` service, `registerApp` and the batch judge; only the reload catches a nested refusal, and it wants the nested writes gone.
- **Existing installs.** A package installed before this change with such a pair loads at every boot (not asked) and serves as it did; its next upgrade or reload is refused until corrected. The upgrade-guide entry says so.
- **ADR-0087.** An entry is owed and registered (see above); the changeset bumps `@objectstack/objectql` minor and `@objectstack/spec` patch.
